cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Turgo uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.whatAreCookiesDesc: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your experience.
cookies.necessaryDesc: These cookies are essential for the website to function properly. They enable basic features like page navigation and access to secure areas.
cookies.analyticsDesc: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously.
cookies.marketingDesc: These cookies are used to track visitors across websites to display relevant advertisements.
cookies.manageDesc: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Removing or blocking cookies may impact your user experience.
cookies.contactDesc: If you have questions about our use of cookies, contact us at privacy@turgo.io
